_comment: To add more downstream repositories, add them to the repositories array above. Each repository should have: owner, repo, gemspec (the .gemspec filename), and description (for the job name). Set "experimental": true to mark that downstream's legs continue-on-error (yellow-with-annotation instead of red) while a known integration migration is pending. relaton carries it until it migrates to pubid 2.0 (the .base_identifier -> .base rename); tracked in #409.
